messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty INCIDENT PD-93421 triggered for service=scale-controller, severity=high, reason=queue_backlog > 1000. Affected route: /v1/generate. Links: https://pd/redwood/PD-93421
maria: I'm on it. seeing spike in queue length and a ton of 429s from dispatchers. can someone confirm autoscaler health?
aj: acked the page :white_check_mark: jumping in to check HPA metrics
ops-bot: Incident created in #incidents with runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/autoscaler-backpressure
luca: reading metrics, node-provision lag at 240s, provision_errors=12, scale-controller reconcile latency spiking. probably hitting provider quota (spot preemptions)
maria: logs from scale-controller:
```
I0305 12:02:10 scale.go:320] reconcile start
E0305 12:02:12 provisioner.go:88] failed to claim node: quota exceeded
W0305 12:02:25 queue.go:447] enqueue backlog size=1187
```
aj: kubectl on cluster prod:
```
kubectl -n inference get hpa
kubectl -n inference describe deployment inference-dispatcher
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=scale-controller --tail=200
```
oncall-runner: running `k8s-provision-status` check, payload:
```
provider: aws
available_spot_nodes: 0
on_demand_available: 4
pending_node_provision: 32
```
sre_tilly: customers: a few PLG customers seeing timeouts >30s and 500s. capacity exhausted for large models. We need fast mitigation: enable fallback routing to smaller model and open reserved burst pool.
luca: can we temporarily route low-priority requests to a degraded tier? add policy `route.fallback=low-cost` for routes matching /v1/generate
maria: triggering manual burst: ops-bot, can you spin reserved GPU pool +20 nodes of g5? we'll pay the cost.
ops-bot: manual-reserve initiated by maria. command:
```
opsctl reserve --pool inference-burst --count 20 --instance g5.xlarge --reason "PD-93421 emergency"
```
ops-bot: reserve request accepted, but provisioning time ~6-8m. will update.
aj: meanwhile disabling batching aggregation to reduce head-of-line blocking on individual requests. patch pushed to dispatcher: `disable-agg=true`
oncall-runner: pushed canary change to route lower-token requests to small-model v1.3. logs show drop in queue growth: backlog -> 860
maria: update customers: filing incident notice to status page and triage. short note: "We are experiencing increased latency and request queuing due to capacity exhaustion in inference autoscaler. Engineers are mitigating with fallback routing and adding emergency capacity."
aj: seeing provisioner error rate drop from 16% -> 5% since reserve started. node count increasing: 12 -> 18
luca: queue processing rate improved, p50 latency down from 1.8s -> 0.9s for small-model routed traffic. large-model queue still high but holding.
sre_tilly: escalate to SRE L2 if large-model backlog > 500 after 15m. notifying evan and priya.
evans: @sre_tilly got the ping, joining in
maria: preparing rollback plan if reserve fails: 1) throttle incoming non-auth traffic 2) reject heavy ops with 429 3) enable pre-warmed on-demand nodes in a different region
oncall-runner: PD acknowledged by aj at 12:03:18 UTC. PD escalation timer reset.
ops-bot: reserve completed at 12:09:02 UTC, nodes ready: +18 g5
aj: scaling controller picked up new nodes, replicas for inference-dispatcher increased from 24 -> 44
maria: backlog trending down: 860 -> 210 in 7m. still monitoring for errors
luca: deploying a config to reduce max_seq_length for non-enterprise customers to limit token consumption (hotfix). patch applied.
oncall-runner: status update to incident channel: mitigation in progress, no customer data exposure, partial degradation for high-token workloads only.
sre_tilly: reaction :thumbsup: good job. please keep 1hr post-mortem slot at 14:00 UTC to review root cause (scale-controller reconcile delays, provider quota/spot churn)
aj: leaving a note for postmortem: collect scale-controller reconciles, provider quota events, node provisioning traces, HPA target errors, and request-level traces for /v1/generate
maria: closing the page in PD, will re-open if backlog reverses. last check: queue=178, 5xx rate normalizing.
pagerduty-bot: PD-93421 resolved by maria at 12:15:40 UTC :white_check_mark:
oncall-runner: handover to next oncall at 13:00 UTC. follow-up tasks assigned: create runbook step for emergency reserve, add provider quota alert, add fallback routing test to CI.
maria: thanks all. filing the incident stub now.
